transcript.text: What was the total net revenue for the focus region in calendar year 2025? Compute net revenue as amount minus discount over completed orders only, amounts are integer US cents (divide by 100), in USD rounded to the nearest cent.

args.sql:
SELECT SUM(o.amount - o.discount) AS net_cents, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'West' AND o.status = 'completed'
AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
